title: DRIP-R: A Benchmark for Decision-Making and Reasoning Under Real-World Policy Ambiguity in the Retail Domain
abstract: arXiv:2605.07699v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed for routine but consequential tasks in real-world domains, where their behavior is governed by inherently ambiguous domain policies that admit multiple valid interpretations. Despite the prevalence of such ambiguities in practice, existing agent benchmarks largely assume unambiguous, well-specified policies, leaving a critical evaluation gap. We introduce DRIP-R, a benchmark that systematically exploits real-world retail policy ambiguities to construct scenarios in which no single correct resolution exists. DRIP-R comprises a curated set of policy-ambiguous return scenarios paired with a realistic customer personas, a full-duplex conversational simulation with tool-calling capabilities and a multi-judge evaluation framework covering policy adherence, dialogue quality, behavioral alignment, and resolution quality. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07699v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正日益被部署到真实世界领域中常规但影响重大的任务上，而其行为受到本质上模糊、可作多种合理解释的领域政策约束。尽管此类模糊性在实践中普遍存在，现有的智能体基准测试大多假设政策是明确无歧义的，从而留下了一个关键的评估空白。我们提出了DRIP-R，这是一个系统性利用真实世界零售政策模糊性来构建不存在唯一正确解决方案场景的基准测试。DRIP-R包含一套精心策划的具有政策模糊性的退货场景，并配有逼真的客户画像、具备工具调用能力的全双工对话模拟，以及涵盖政策遵循度、对话质量、行为一致性和解决质量的多评判者评估框架。我们的实验表明，前沿模型在相同……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DRIP-R是一个系统性利用真实世界零售政策模糊性、构建“无唯一正确答案”场景的LLM智能体基准测试，通过模糊退货场景、客户画像、全双工对话模拟与多评判者评估框架，揭示了前沿模型在政策模糊情境下存在根本性的决策分歧。
en_tdlr: DRIP-R is a benchmark that systematically exploits real-world retail policy ambiguities to construct scenarios with no single correct resolution, revealing that frontier LLM agents fundamentally disagree when making decisions under ambiguous policies.
